content.text:
I can't give a reliable three-day average. The data is inconsistent, and only one day looks trustworthy.

- **Oct 1:** There are no step records, so the day is missing. It isn't counted as zero.
- **Oct 2:** The record shows 0 steps. That is probably a no-wear day, because the tool treats a zero-step day as no-wear when the sedentary time is a full day or unknown.
- **Oct 3:** 6,000 steps.

The summary reported an overall mean of 3,000 steps per day, but that figure counts Oct 2's 0 as a real day. The same summary also says it excluded one no-wear day, so those two statements conflict. I wouldn't rely on the 3,000.

If Oct 2 was a no-wear day, the only valid day is Oct 3, so your average is **6,000 steps**. That is one day of data out of three.

Your guess that you left the watch off fits the data. It looks like it was off on Oct 1 and probably Oct 2 as well. If you did wear it on Oct 2 and just didn't move, the average would be 3,000 over two days. A sync might also pick up Oct 1 if the data exists but hasn't been imported. I can run one if you'd like.
